entities.name: First Anglo-Afghan War
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Britain's disastrous invasion of Afghanistan to install a puppet ruler, the retreat from Kabul, and the annihilation of the 16,500-strong British-Indian column — one of the greatest military disasters in British history.
